variants.strategy: Use explicit stack objects for lower and upper hulls, emphasize pop operations when a right turn occurs.
variants.tracker_code:
def trace(input_data):
    sess = TraceSession(
        algorithm="Convex Hull (Andrew's Monotone Chain)",
        input_data=input_data,
        pseudocode=[
            "Sort points by (x, y)",
            "Build lower hull using a stack",
            "Build upper hull using a second stack",
            "Combine to get counterclockwise hull"
        ]
    )
    raw_pts = input_data["points"]
    pts = sorted(raw_pts, key=lambda p: (p[0], p[1]))
    point_obj = sess.points("delivery_points", pts)

    def cross(o, a, b):
        return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1]) - (a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])

    # Use stack objects for lower and upper
    lower_stack = sess.stack("lower_stack", [])
    upper_stack = sess.stack("upper_stack", [])

    with sess.step("Build lower hull"):
        lower_mirror = []
        for i, p in enumerate(pts):
            point_obj.highlight(i, role="current")
            sess.note(f"Processing point {p}")
            while len(lower_mirror) >= 2 and cross(lower_mirror[-2], lower_mirror[-1], p) <= 0:
                popped = lower_mirror.pop()
                lower_stack.pop(reason=f"Pop {popped} (right turn)")
            lower_mirror.append(p)
            lower_stack.push(p, reason=f"Push {p}")

    with sess.step("Build upper hull"):
        upper_mirror = []
        for i, p in enumerate(reversed(pts)):
            orig_idx = len(pts) - 1 - i
            point_obj.highlight(orig_idx, role="current")
            sess.note(f"Processing point {p}")
            while len(upper_mirror) >= 2 and cross(upper_mirror[-2], upper_mirror[-1], p) <= 0:
                popped = upper_mirror.pop()
                upper_stack.pop(reason=f"Pop {popped} (right turn)")
            upper_mirror.append(p)
            upper_stack.push(p, reason=f"Push {p}")

    hull = lower_mirror[:-1] + upper_mirror[:-1]
    sess.result(hull)

    return sess.to_trace()
